entries.title: Technical Support Consultant (Full-Stack Software Engineer)
entries.summary: Startup-style product team working directly with a firm partner; ships rapid applications prioritized by usage metrics.
bullets: Appointed team AI Champion (2025): teach engineers AI-assisted workflows, run AI Lunch & Learns, and represent the team with the firm's AI enablement group on tool selection.

Lead developer of the Domestic Content web app: multi-tenant compliance software for Inflation Reduction Act tax-credit programs in Python and PostgreSQL, with S3-to-PostgreSQL ingestion, a penalty-calculating rules engine, Tableau views, tenant isolation, RBAC and pen-test remediation.

Building a documentation-grounded AI chatbot for portal users' how-to questions, shaped through user interviews and the platform's lead PM; built an internal workbench to edit and trace each chatbot step and compare LLMs.

Designed a chain of modular AI workflows that take a ticket from requirements to QA: an interview saves business context, a technical pass builds on it, unclear requirements go to the PM or a senior engineer, and tests and mocks are written from team templates before the code.

entries.title: Founder & AI Engineer
entries.summary: Multi-agent LLM coaching platform: an intake agent routes each user to one of twelve advisor agents; declarative orchestration with per-node tracing, two-layer guardrails, token budgets.
bullets: Built the platform end to end on FastAPI, Claude, Next.js, TypeScript, PostgreSQL and AWS: orchestration spec and runtime, per-node trace events streamed over SSE and stored per run, and a Backstage workbench to inspect them.
Guardrails in two layers (prompt rules plus an LLM engagement judge), per-user token budgets with metering, Clerk JWKS auth with a per-endpoint ownership audit; 199 tests and 41 versioned migrations.
Validate demand with about fifty in-person user interviews in Austin and feedback from the framework's author, a C-suite PR advisor and a founder coach; six major pivots driven by testing.

entries.title: AI Engineer (Contract)
entries.summary: Agentic RAG for a global oil and gas company on a small, fast-moving team.
bullets: Built agentic RAG workflows (LangGraph, LangChain) answering questions over large structured and unstructured datasets.

With the architect, built a serverless multi-agent pipeline: a router Lambda sizes each question, a context manager fans out specialist Lambdas (dataset, web, quantitative search) to S3, and EventBridge triggers a finalizer that streams the answer over WebSocket.
Built retrieval with embedding-based semantic search on OpenSearch, dataset-linked tools ranked per question, and token-efficiency techniques; reviewed junior developers' code.

entries.title: Software Engineer (Contract via Pinnacle Group)
entries.summary: Migrated Java/Spring Boot microservices to AWS with Docker and CI/CD; built React UIs with design, product and BA teams.

entries.title: Freelance Software Developer
entries.summary: Built and launched websites and led a mobile app for small-business clients, working from a UX designer's layouts; owned hosting, domains and forms; set up Hygraph CMS so clients could manage their own content.
bullets: Vanilla JavaScript and direct DOM manipulation first, then React with reusable components, Redux and MobX state management, and load-time optimizations; also Angular and MVC patterns.
Seven client projects are shown under Work. Sky City Trucking, built 2022–23, is live on the client's domain and still brings me in for paid updates.

about.title: About
about.heading: About me
paragraphs: I'm a full-stack software engineer in Austin, TX. I've shipped production code since 2021, and since 2025 most of it has been production AI: retrieval over large structured and unstructured datasets, agentic workflows with validation controls, and the guardrails and traces that make them safe to put in front of users.

At Baker Tilly I'm the lead developer of the Domestic Content web app, multi-tenant compliance software for Inflation Reduction Act tax-credit programs, on a startup-style product team that works directly with a firm partner and ships what usage metrics say matters. I'm also the team's appointed AI Champion: I build the documentation-grounded chatbot for portal users and the workbench that traces each of its steps, design the test-first, human-in-the-loop AI workflows that take a ticket from requirements to QA, run Lunch & Learns, and represent the team with the firm's AI enablement group. At Neurohive, an AI startup, I built agentic RAG for a global oil and gas company: LangGraph workflows, a serverless multi-agent pipeline on Lambda and EventBridge, and semantic search on OpenSearch.

The idea I've carried since I was fifteen is an app that can tell where your thinking is stuck and help you get unstuck. I learned to program to build it: first as a freelancer for small-business owners, then at JPMorgan Chase and Baker Tilly. It's now DramaRama, which I run as Whimsy & Rigor LLC and have tested in person with about fifty users in Austin.
